extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: sport motorboat (runabout) with outboard engine, approx. 6.5 x 2.5 x 1.8 m (L x W x H)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0 with the outboard trimmed slightly up so the skeg clears the ground, add your own water (waterline at 0.40 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: motorboat_propeller (spins around the propeller shaft), motorboat_steering_wheel (turns around its column); opaque tinted windshield; no brand, no text, no number

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
